subject: integration
name: Uniswap
summary: Swaps Ether or a pinned token for a pinned token through Uniswap V3 pools on Ethereum mainnet. The router, quoter and tokens are pinned in Orivon, the price is an eth_call the light client proves, the payee gets the exact amount or the swap reverts (at most 0.5% over the quote), and it is done only on a proven receipt. It holds no funds. The going fee comes from an execution server and nothing checks it; the sheet shows it before Pay. Those servers see the paying address and the swap. Level 3, not 4, because of that fee read. Judged here by its publisher.
